newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 3-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York temporarily added reserves to the banking system on Monday via three-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.

This complements an outstanding seven-day system repo operation and helps meet a daily add need Fed watchers put at $4 billion through Wednesday. Demand for currency is expected to rise going into the September 2 Labor Day holiday.
At 1130 EDT/1530 GMT, the Fed's usual intervention time, federal funds changed hands at 5-1/4 percent, on target.
